JSX Renderer options specification. Optional: docType (boolean | string, default true adds HTML5 DOCTYPE). false: no DOCTYPE. string: custom DOCTYPE like '<!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.1//EN" "http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml11/DTD/xhtml11.dtd">'. Optional: stream (boolean | Record<string, string> for streaming responses). true: enable streaming with chunked Transfer-Encoding. Record: customize headers like {'Transfer-Encoding': 'chunked', 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=UTF-8', 'Content-Encoding': 'Identity'}. Works with Suspense and async components. Enables progressive rendering. Function-based options: (c: Context) => ({docType, stream, ...}) for dynamic per-request config. Example: (c) => ({stream: c.req.header('X-Enable-Streaming') === 'true'}). SSG example: (c) => ({stream: !isSSGContext(c)}) to disable streaming for static generation. Nested layouts pattern with Layout component. Enables multi-level layout composition. Pattern: outer app with jsxRenderer, inner app route with jsxRenderer using Layout. Example: outer app renders main layout, inner blog routes render with Layout component wrapping blog-specific layout. Inner jsxRenderer receives Layout prop: ({children, Layout}) =>. useRequestContext() hook for accessing Context in components. Hook function: useRequestContext() returns Context instance. Type: FC (React Functional Component). Can access c.req.url, c.req.header(), c.req.method, etc. Example: const c = useRequestContext(); return {c.req.url}. Enables access to request properties in JSX components. Deno JSX config: can't use with precompile option (error). Solution: change tsconfig.json "jsx" from "precompile" to "react-jsx". Require "jsxImportSource": "hono/jsx". Extending ContextRenderer for custom props. TypeScript module augmentation: declare module 'hono' { interface ContextRenderer { (content: string | Promise<string>, props: {title: string}): Response; } }. Enables passing custom properties through c.render(). Example: c.render(<component>, {title: 'My favorites'}). Receive props in jsxRenderer layout: ({children, title}) => <html><head><title>{title}</title>... Access custom props in layout component. Allows dynamic head content per page. Pattern: data flows through props to renderer. Questions: How to pass custom props? How to augment types? What's the syntax? Can I pass multiple props? How to use in layout?
